title: SQLite column addition requires default value
content: Adding a NOT NULL column to an existing table in SQLite requires providing a default value, otherwise it will fail. The migration failed because the `owner` column was added without a default, and the existing row had no value.

title: Use make sign publish to ensure signing before publishing
content: The `make publish` command failed because the `.signed` marker was missing. The decision was to run `make sign publish` together to ensure the artifact is signed before attempting to publish.

title: Never edit files under generated/
content: Files under the `generated/` directory are overwritten by the build process and should never be edited manually.

title: CI uses Python 3.9, avoid match statements
content: The CI environment runs Python 3.9, which does not support the `match` statement. Scripts must avoid using it to prevent syntax errors.

title: Releases are deployed to eu-west region
content: All releases are automatically deployed to the `eu-west` region as per the project's configuration.

title: make clean removes .signed marker
content: Running `make clean` removes the `.signed` marker, which is required for publishing. After a clean, the `make sign` command must be run again to regenerate the marker.
